content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the HURL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the HURL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of HURL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Hindustan Urvarak & Rasayan Limited (HURL) for various executive and contract positions across multiple locations in India.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under HURL Advt No E/05/2026?
faq.answer: A total of 11 vacancies have been announced for different posts including Additional Chief Manager, Senior Manager, Deputy Manager, and Assistant Manager positions.

faq.question: Q3. What are the starting and ending dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 16 October 2026 and concludes on 6 November 2026. Interested candidates must submit their applications within this timeframe.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a graduate degree, engineering degree in relevant disciplines (Chemical, Mechanical, etc.), MBA, PG Diploma in Materials Management, or MBBS depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applying to HURL Executive positions?
faq.answer: The upper age limit ranges from 35 to 55 years depending on the specific post and grade, with age calculated as of 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for HURL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for submitting the online application form for these vacancies.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for HURL Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting and screening tests, written tests, trade tests, or skill tests as deemed appropriate, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the HURL recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official HURL career portal or HRMS job portal, registering themselves, and submitting the required details and documents.

faq.question: Q9. What are the job locations for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates may be posted at various HURL operational units including Gorakhpur in Uttar Pradesh, Sindri in Jharkhand, and Barauni in Bihar.

faq.question: Q10. What is the cutoff date for calculating age and experience?
faq.answer: The cutoff date for calculating both the candidate's age and post-qualification experience eligibility is 30 September 2026.
